name: Jill N. Tokuda
summary:
Jill Naomi Tokuda (born March 3, 1976) is an American politician and business owner serving since 2023 as the U.S. representative for Hawaii's 2nd congressional district.
As of 2026, Tokuda is one of four Japanese Americans who serve in the House of Representatives. A member of the Democratic Party, she represented the 24th district in the Hawaii Senate from 2006 to 2018.
